title: Gift Cards & Store Credit: Annual Issue Caps and Documented-Failure Requirement
content:
Of all Gift Cards & Store Credit types, only Goodwill Credit carries annual issue caps per customer, and only Goodwill Credit requires an approved or resolved delivery claim on record before it is issued. A cap figure of 0 means that the type has no cap.

| Instrument type | Requires an approved or resolved delivery claim on record | Most instruments issued to one customer in a trailing 12 months | Most value issued to one customer in a trailing 12 months (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note | No | 0 (no cap) | 0.00 (no cap) |
| Bonus Gift Card | No | 0 (no cap) | 0.00 (no cap) |
| Goodwill Credit | Yes | 3 | 150.00 |
| Return Store Credit | No | 0 (no cap) | 0.00 (no cap) |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | No | 0 (no cap) | 0.00 (no cap) |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | No | 0 (no cap) | 0.00 (no cap) |

## Points of reading

- **Two separate ceilings for Goodwill Credit.** The count ceiling is three Goodwill Credits and the value ceiling is 150.00 of Goodwill Credit, each measured over a trailing 12 months for one customer.
- **A zero is not a ban.** For the five other types the 0 and 0.00 entries mean there is no cap on how many instruments, or how much value, a customer may be issued.
- **Documented failure.** The requirement in the first column is met only by a delivery claim whose status is approved or resolved; for every type marked No, no delivery claim is needed for issue.
